title: Consolidate product memory into the trunk and correct stale records
requested_outcome: Consolidate CLIVE's product memory and make it true again. Two branches of product memory were never merged, and they are now staged on the trunk, byte-identical to their sources: crooks-assistant/docs/product-memory/_incoming/truth/ (the kernel-accepted PM-01 to PM-04 truth branch, built on the 2026-09-23 reconciliation) and _incoming/handoff/ (the Opus 5.5 handoff documents). The canonical files in crooks-assistant/docs/product-memory already hold the 2026-09-24 and 2026-09-25 records (GENERATIVE_UI_V1, OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-09-24, PROJECT_AUDIT_2026-09-24, SOURCE_ASSIMILATION_V1, SOURCE_SHELF, OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-09-25, CLIVE_SELF_KNOWLEDGE, NEXT_PHASE_2026-09-25, INFRASTRUCTURE_2026-09-25, EXTERNAL_REVIEW_2026-09-25); give every idea captured in NEXT_PHASE_2026-09-25 section 3 its own entry in IDEAS.md with the next free identifier, pointing to existing entries where it extends one, and add the approved next phase to ROADMAP.md. Bring every decision, idea, feature and document from both _incoming trees into the canonical files, resolving differences in CURRENT_TRUTH.md, DECISIONS.md, IDEAS.md, FEATURES.md, ROADMAP.md and README.md so that nothing recorded on any side is lost, identifiers stay unique, and every document is indexed exactly once. Leave the _incoming directory exactly as it is: you cannot delete files, and the Director removes it after this lands. Then correct what no longer matches reality, using these facts as of 2026-09-25: production (/opt/crooks-os) runs clive/trunk ce791d03, deployed on 2026-09-25 after GitHub acceptance and an independent exact-SHA review with zero findings; it includes Live Experience V0.5, the mobile alpha, derived truth and attention V1, the mobile dogfood voice rules, the support investigator revisions, the judgment ledger CI stream and corrections, and the age-days floor. Merged to the trunk since, not yet deployed: needs-reply routing, the microphone permission fix, the voice-credits wording and health, and the remote-engineering journal-safe repair. The remote engineering loop runs on three machines (the production host, two builders; clive-worker-01, an HPE server with eight builders; the owner's Mac is being set up), all on claude-opus-5-5, and the owner's one-trunk rule governs what counts as finished. The bridge watcher was retired on 2026-09-25; engineering-team-activation-v1 is superseded by the remote loop. Gmail OAuth was provisioned on 2026-09-24. The Derek voice is unavailable on the server because the ElevenLabs credits are exhausted, so FEAT-006 is not shipped there. Update FEATURES.md statuses, CURRENT_TRUTH.md and ROADMAP.md accordingly, keeping history as history rather than deleting it; where a document is superseded, mark it so. The previous attempt stopped because a reviewer finding asked for evidence only something that runs commands can produce: the loop's listed checks are that evidence, so complete the content and report; do not block for want of running commands yourself. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: every decision, idea, feature and document in both _incoming trees is present in the canonical files and indexed once; _incoming itself is left unchanged
no recorded decision or idea is lost and every identifier stays unique
FEATURES.md, CURRENT_TRUTH.md and ROADMAP.md match the stated facts about production and the loops, with history kept
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
